LanguageData.CC_MoodC_CompactTip: One line per mood, grouped by what you can do about it, each with what helps. Hover a line for everything about it; click it for its card and buttons.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_DetailsTip: Every mood as a card: why it's there, when it fades, where it comes from and what helps.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_Tip_Fix: Moods you can do something about now, biggest first. Each line says what helps; click one for its card, with buttons to the advisor, the council page or the Almanac.\n\nClick to go there.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_Tip_Pass: Memories that fade on their own, and moods that end with what caused them. Good moments balance them out in the meantime: a fine meal, recreation, time with friends.\n\nClick to go there.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_Tip_Faith: Moods from their faith, their traits or genes, and moods that never fade. Honor the belief where you can, or plan around who they are.\n\nClick to go there.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_Tip_Lifting: The good moods holding them up.\n\nClick to go there.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_ClickForCard: Click for its card: why, what helps, and where to go about it.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_NothingBadColony: Nothing weighs on the colony right now.
LanguageData.CC_MoodC_NeedsTip: Rimfolk sorts {0}'s moods by what you can do about them: what you can fix now, what will pass on its own, what comes from faith or who they are, and what lifts them.\n\nClick to open the Mood tab, with what helps for each.
